howToApply: Visit the official recruitment portal: https://www.hphcrecruitment.in/login or https://highcourt.hp.gov.in/
Read the R&P Rules, 2015 carefully before applying.
Ensure eligibility in respect of essential qualification(s), category, age, and experience.

Scan and keep ready: coloured recent photograph (20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (10-20 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), Matric Certificate (100-500 KB), ID Proof (100-500 KB), and other certificates/documents (100 KB to 2 MB, PDF).
Fill the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) form on the recruitment portal.
Upload all required documents and certificates.
Pay the examination fee ONLY through online mode.
Submit the application before 27.10.2026 at 11:59 PM.
Take a printout/screenshot of the submitted application for record.
Candidates already in government service must submit application through proper channel with NOC within 15 days from the last date.

title: HPPSC Recruitment 2026 – Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) Group-A (Job Trainee) Posts
shortInfo: HPPSC has announced notification for Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) Group-A (Job Trainee) posts. Required qualification: B.Sc. (Agr.), M.Sc. (Agri). Last date to apply: 22-10-26.

fees.category: All Candidates (irrespective of category or gender)

howToApply: Visit the official website of HPPSC at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the link ‘Apply Online’ on the Home Page.
Click on ‘One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations’ and register/create your profile by clicking ‘New Registration’ if not already registered.
Log into your OTR account and select the relevant advertisement from the dashboard.

Fill in all required details carefully and upload all requisite documents (Matriculation certificate, Degree certificates, Category certificates, Bonafide Himachali certificate, Experience certificate if required, etc.).
Pay the examination fee of Rs. 600/- online via Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI or any other online digital mode.
Give an undertaking/declaration that all uploaded documents are legible, readable and true.
Submit the application before the closing date of 22/10/2026 by 11:59 PM.
Note: Once submitted, no corrections/modifications can be made to the application.

howToApply: Visit the official website of HPBoSE at www.hpbose.org.
Click on ‘CET/Vacancy’ option and select the link ‘HP TET November-2026’.
Enter your 12-digit Aadhar Number and select the subject for HP TET November-2026.

Fill in personal details including Name, Father’s/Mother’s Name (as per Matriculation certificate in CAPITAL LETTERS), Date of Birth, Category, Sub-category, Gender, Contact/Mobile Number, Email ID, Nationality, and Address.
Upload scanned images of photograph (JPG, less than 20 KB, 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm) and signature (JPG, less than 15 KB, 3.5 cm x 1.5 cm).
Pay the examination fee through Payment Gateway via Net Banking or Debit/Credit Card.
Submit the declaration and take a printout of the Confirmation Page for future reference.
Note the Application Number generated after successful submission for future use (Application Number as User ID and Date of Birth as Password).
In case of more than one teaching subject/category, submit a separate online application and fee for each category.
